name: Senraku-an Small Tea Room (Sendagi)
editor_note: A small tea room in Sendagi, a quiet old-Tokyo neighborhood next to Yanaka, far calmer than the Asakusa crowds. Platform-only listing we haven't visited ourselves.
price_note: from ¥8,000 per person per a GetYourGuide-powered listing (jasumo.com), read 2026-11-03. Not yet confirmed on GetYourGuide itself.
notes: 4-18-19 Sendagi, Bunkyo. About 7 min walk from Nishi-Nippori Station.
